title: Metadata validation: remove count in csv
author: etj
body_preview: In the csv output there's a column reporting the total number of errors for a resource. The same number is repeated in all the lines in which the resource shows up. title: [API v3] Bootstrap the /api/v3/ entry point
author: etj
body_preview: ### Why  Every v3 resource needs the same router, pagination, and field-selection mechanism.  Building that once first keeps the resource issues small.  ### What  - The `/api/v3/` router and URL wiring. - Shared base pieces: bounded pagination, a base viewset, the `?fields=`  mechanism, and the explicit-permissions requirement. - No resource endpoints in this issue.
